import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

class TestMain(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.mock_project = MagicMock()
        self.mock_editor = MagicMock()
        self.mock_document = MagicMock()
        self.mock_document.getText.return_value = "def test():\n    pass"
        self.mock_editor.getDocument.return_value = self.mock_document
        self.mock_editor.getCaretModel.return_value = MagicMock()
        self.mock_editor.getCaretModel().getPrimaryCaret.return_value = MagicMock()
        self.mock_editor.getCaretModel().getPrimaryCaret().getOffset.return_value = 0

    def test_plugin_initialization(self):
        with patch('main.PluginService') as mock_service:
            mock_service.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import PluginService
            self.assertIsNotNone(PluginService)

    def test_context_capture(self):
        with patch('main.ContextCapture') as mock_capture:
            mock_capture.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import ContextCapture
            self.assertIsNotNone(ContextCapture)

    def test_state_persistence(self):
        with patch('main.StateManager') as mock_state:
            mock_state.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import StateManager
            self.assertIsNotNone(StateManager)

    def test_tool_window_creation(self):
        with patch('main.ToolWindowFactory') as mock_factory:
            mock_factory.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import ToolWindowFactory
            self.assertIsNotNone(ToolWindowFactory)

    def test_annotation_provider(self):
        with patch('main.AnnotationProvider') as mock_provider:
            mock_provider.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import AnnotationProvider
            self.assertIsNotNone(AnnotationProvider)

    def test_workflow_automation(self):
        with patch('main.WorkflowAutomation') as mock_automation:
            mock_automation.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import WorkflowAutomation
            self.assertIsNotNone(WorkflowAutomation)

    def test_configuration_management(self):
        with patch('main.ConfigurationManager') as mock_config:
            mock_config.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import ConfigurationManager
            self.assertIsNotNone(ConfigurationManager)

    def test_project_navigation(self):
        with patch('main.ProjectNavigation') as mock_nav:
            mock_nav.return_value = MagicMock()
            from main import ProjectNavigation
            self.assertIsNotNone(ProjectNavigation)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
